$comment: Notification registry v1 (V1-S18). Single source of codes for the Web (HTTP modules/notifications.yaml) and the plugin (adapter protocol 1.3). Owner: Software Architect (Compasso). params names a $defs entry of params.schema.json, which check_openapi.py generates from the HTTP bundle (NotificationParamsByCode). Texts live in each client's pt-BR/en catalog; drift test: every code has a key in both languages in both clients. Receivers never refuse an unknown code or params that fail their copy: they render a generic text with code and severity, keep the item, its count and read state, and ack the frame (ADR-0004 §9, note 1.3.2). A new severity, target.kind or category is still a protocol change. Grouping is Core-side: no protocol frame carries a grouping (the frames carry the item already grouped), so a new grouping is a registry minor, not a protocol change (Esquadro).

groupings.none: every occurrence is its own notification
groupings.account_trading_day: same code + account + trading day collapse into one item (count, last time); the first occurrence is unread; a later one marks the group unread again only when the code has reopen_on_occurrence: true (Q68)
groupings.firm_release: one item per firm and release, with account_count
groupings.connection_trading_day: same code + connection + trading day collapse into one item (count, last time); the first occurrence is unread, later ones never reopen it
groupings.source_trading_day: same code + source + trading day collapse into one item (count, last time); the first occurrence is unread, later ones never reopen it

routing.instrument_unavailable.rule: 5.2.0 (Esquadro): the instrument is in the catalog but has no active contract at the decision; params carry instrument_symbol

routing.adapter_protocol_outdated.rule: 5.3.0 (ADR-0004 r5 §7.1, U13): the session is too old for the action (a reduce below 1.2; entries of an account with a drawdown rule below 1.4). Entries are skipped and exits continue; the text asks the user to update the plugin

routing.position_unknown.rule: 5.3.0 (U13 A): a reduce skipped because the Core holds no All Win identity for the position (e.g. opened externally on a TradingView-only destination)

routing.nothing_to_reduce.rule: Q76: notified when the account is out of sync, read when the notification is produced; if the sync state is unavailable at that moment, it IS notified (more transparency, never less; ADR-0003 r4 §4.1). On an in-sync account it stays audit only (a benign race with a stop/target fill). A reduce is never sent as a flatten

routing.reverse_close_only.rule: Q74: always sent, one per occurrence, for every gate including routing.limits_pending; for an open leg that expired at routing (routing.expired, 5.1.0); and for an open leg that expired in the gateway queue under the ADR-0004 §5 reverse exception (routing.expired, 5.1.1). Replaces the gate's grouped notification for that occurrence. Q75 (expected_flat, out of sync): not sent at the decision; when the flatten is terminal, sent with reason_code routing.out_of_sync and closed_qty/closed_side from its fills if it filled; on command.already_flat routing.out_of_sync_flatten is sent instead

routing.out_of_sync_flatten.rule: Q75: once per flatten sent on an out-of-sync account with a flat expected position that ends in a terminal success (filled or command.already_flat), except a reverse that filled (routing.reverse_close_only). The text says that any working orders on the contract were cancelled, manual ones included

risk.evaluation_target_reached.rule: once per evaluation count (S13b; Q70: notify only, nothing automatic)

risk.blocked.rule: S15 (1.6.0): one per block until the reset (AC-2, AC-8)

risk.flatten.rule: S15 (1.6.0): one per enforcement action (flattened, orders_cancelled)

risk.unblocked.rule: S15 AC-9 (1.6.0): the trading-day reset ended the block

risk.reactive_block_action.rule: S15 AC-6 (1.6.0): manual orders cancelled while blocked, grouped per account and trading day; a later one does not mark the group unread (Q68 b: only the listed danger codes reopen)

connection.status_changed.rule: only for the statuses listed in severity_by_params

sync.flagged.rule: S11: one occurrence per sync reason added (params.reason = that reason); the three bracket reasons use their own code instead for that occurrence. Grouped per account and trading day; a new reason marks the group unread again (Q99 yes, user 2026-10-24: a group the user read or dismissed reopens on a new reason)

sync.bracket_orphan_leg.rule: S11 AC-5 i: flat with an orphan protective leg, cancelled automatically; params.reason.core_action lists what was cancelled. Replaces sync.flagged for that occurrence

sync.bracket_incomplete.rule: S11 AC-5 ii: open position without stop or target, or orders in an unknown state; nothing was recreated. Replaces sync.flagged for that occurrence

sync.bracket_double_fill.rule: S11 AC-5 iii (Q27 b): both legs filled; only the position created by the orphan leg was flattened (params.reason.core_action). Maximum priority. Replaces sync.flagged for that occurrence

sync.flatten_failed_unprotected.rule: U19 (user), Esmeril M1: a flatten of ANY origin (close, reverse incl. Q75, Q27 orphan-leg flatten, S15 local enforcement) failed after cancelling protection, and the position stays open with protection lost. Replaces sync.flagged for that occurrence. A failed flatten with protection intact is sync.flagged (danger)

sync.restored.rule: ADR-0004 §6: a disconnect while flat with nothing in flight; the reconnect snapshot matched, so the account was never flagged and is back to normal

execution.unbound_activity.rule: S11 (Esquadro; Crivo R1): a snapshot shows a new or changed position on a platform account visible on the connection but bound to no All Win account; one audit entry per (connection, platform account, instrument) change, fills not one by one; grouped per connection and trading day; not a sync reason

ingress.duplicate_conflict.rule: 5.4.0/6.0.0 (Esquadro): same message_id with a different compared field; nothing executed. Grouped per source and trading day. Target = the original instruction (the producer knows its id; s18 §3). No account_id on the item
